questions.stem: A 35-year-old male patient is brought to the ER after sustaining trauma to his spine during a car accident. The bystanders reported that he was not found wearing a seatbelt. Examination reveals weakness in motor movements on the right side with hyperactive reflexes. Suspecting Brown-Sequard syndrome, which of the following clinical findings will be observed in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Contralateral loss of joint sense and position

options.label: C
options.text: Ipsilateral loss of complete sensory functions
